item.title: War's New Arithmetic: How Cheap Drones Beat Expensive Arsenals
item.description: A revolution in the character of war has already happened, and most arsenals have not caught up. The cheap, mass-produced drone has made the tank, the warship and the manned strike aircraft no longer decisive — and the side that out-produces and out-thinks the other in cheap precision now wins. This is not how one war is being won; it is the new face of war as such.

item.title: The Junior Partner: Russia's Vassalage to China
item.description: Putin went to war to build a multipolar world that would dethrone the West and restore Russia to the front rank. The multipolar world arrived on schedule — and it crowned Beijing, not Moscow. What looks like a strategic pivot to China is in truth a national demotion: Russia is becoming a tribute-paying resource colony of a power that builds belts, not alliances.
